description: This Java class 'IPv4Helper' provides utility methods for converting IPv4 addresses between string and long representations, checking if an IP address is within a specified range, and identifying if the application is running on a local machine.

classes.name: IPv4Helper
classes.description: Utility class for IPv4 address conversions and checks, non-instantiable with private constructor.

methods.name: ipAddressToLong
methods.description: Converts a dotted IPv4 address string to its equivalent long representation, throwing IllegalArgumentException for invalid inputs.

methods.name: longToIpAddress
methods.description: Converts a long integer back to its dotted IPv4 address string, validating the range.

methods.name: ipAddressIsInRange
methods.description: Checks whether a given IP address falls within a specified start and end range.

methods.name: applicationIsRunningOnLocalMachine
methods.description: Determines if the Java application is running on a local machine by examining the host IP address.

methods.name: applicationIsNotRunningOnLocalMachine
methods.description: Negation of applicationIsRunningOnLocalMachine; returns true if not running on local machine.
